items.jp: 赤ん坊が眠っている。音を立てるな。

translation.pt-BR: O bebê está dormindo. Não faça barulho.
translation.en: The baby is asleep. Don't make a noise.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: Marks 音 ('noise') as the object of 立てる ('to make'): it is the noise that (must not) be produced.

items.jp: 人々は将来のことを心配しているようだった。

translation.pt-BR: As pessoas pareciam estar preocupadas com o futuro.
translation.en: People seemed to be anxious about the future.

items.label: direct-object particle (o)
items.explanation: Marks 将来のこと as the object of the worry: it is ABOUT this that the people are worried (心配する governs を).
tokens: noun that forms the verb with する
auxiliary of appearance/inference (stem of ようだ)

items.jp: 人を見たら泥棒と思え。

translation.pt-BR: Trate todo desconhecido como um possível ladrão.
translation.en: Never trust a stranger.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を points to 人 (person) as the target of the verb 見る (to see): 'to see a person'.

items.jp: 女はテーブルのナイフに手を伸ばした。

translation.pt-BR: A mulher estendeu a mão para a faca sobre a mesa.
translation.en: The woman reached for the knife on the table.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 手 (the hand) as the object directly affected/moved by the verb 伸ばす (to extend).

items.jp: 塩を渡してもらえませんか。

translation.pt-BR: Você poderia me passar o sal?
translation.en: Would you be kind enough to pass the salt?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 塩 (salt) is what is to be passed, the object of the verb 渡す.

items.jp: 引力によって物体が重さを持つようになる。

translation.pt-BR: Por causa da gravidade, os objetos passam a ter peso.
translation.en: Gravity causes objects to have weight.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 重さ as the direct object of 持つ (to have weight).
tokens: verb of the によって phrase (cause)
formal noun in ようになる

items.jp: メイドはテーブルにナイフとフォークを並べた。

translation.pt-BR: A empregada arrumou as facas e os garfos na mesa.
translation.en: The maid arranged the knives and forks on the table.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what undergoes the action of 並べる; the set 'knives and forks' is what was arranged.

items.jp: それは問題をより複雑にするでしょう。

translation.pt-BR: Isso vai complicar mais as coisas.
translation.en: That'll complicate matters more.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates 問題 as what will be affected by the action of 複雑にする (to make complicated).
tokens: linking auxiliary (the に of the copula)

items.jp: その緑のシャツを見せてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, me mostre aquela camisa verde.
translation.en: Please show me the green shirt.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 緑のシャツ (the green shirt) as the object one asks to be shown.

items.jp: しばらくこの町に腰を落ちつけようと思うんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Estou pensando em me fixar nesta cidade por um tempo.
translation.en: I think I'll stay put in this town for a while.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: Marks 腰 as the object within the idiom 腰を落ち着ける ('to settle down').
tokens: direct object (of the idiom 腰を落ち着ける)
main verb of the matrix clause

items.jp: ここにゴミを捨てるべからず。

translation.pt-BR: Não jogue lixo aqui.
translation.en: Don't throw trash here.

items.label: marks the direct object of the verb
items.explanation: を marks ゴミ ('trash') as that which undergoes the action of 捨てる ('to throw away'); hence 'to throw out the trash.'

items.jp: あなたは歴史のどの時代を研究していますか。

translation.pt-BR: Qual período da história você está estudando?
translation.en: Which period of history are you studying?

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks どの時代 ('which era') as the object of the verb 研究する ('to study').
tokens: noun that forms the verb with する

items.jp: 両親が来る前に、家を掃除しようと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Pretendo limpar a casa antes de meus pais chegarem.
translation.en: I would like to clean up the house before my parents come.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: Marks 家 ('house') as that which will be cleaned by 掃除する.
tokens: main verb of the quoted clause (volitional)
main verb of the matrix clause

items.jp: カップケーキ型に、ペーパーカップを並べます。

translation.pt-BR: Coloque as forminhas de papel na forma de cupcake.
translation.en: Set up paper cups in the cupcake baking tray.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that ペーパーカップ ('the paper liners') is what receives the action of arranging.

items.jp: 練習が完成を生む。

translation.pt-BR: A prática leva à perfeição.
translation.en: Practice makes perfect.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 完成 ('perfection/completion') as the direct target of the verb 生む: it is what practice 'produces.'

items.jp: 卵をゆでてほしいのです。

translation.pt-BR: Eu queria que você cozinhasse o ovo.
translation.en: I want a boiled egg.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 卵 ('egg') as the target of the action of cooking (ゆでる).

items.jp: 母は娘にそのおもちゃを片づけるように言った。

translation.pt-BR: A mãe disse à filha para guardar aqueles brinquedos.
translation.en: The mother told her daughter to put those toys away.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks そのおもちゃ (those toys) as what should be put away by the verb 片づける.

items.jp: 布団をはがされた。

translation.pt-BR: Tiraram o meu futon de mim.
translation.en: My futon was peeled away.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: を marks 布団 as what undergoes the action of yanking off. Even in the passive, Japanese keeps を here because the action 'yanking off the futon' falls on the futon.

items.jp: 布団をたたみなさい。

translation.pt-BR: Dobre o futon.
translation.en: Fold up your bedding.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 布団 ('futon') is the object on which the action of folding (たたむ) falls.

items.jp: 彼女は鳥かごを軒からつるした。

translation.pt-BR: Ela pendurou a gaiola no beiral.
translation.en: She hung the cage from the eaves.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 鳥かご (the birdcage) is what undergoes the action of hanging.

items.jp: 布団をしまいなさい。

translation.pt-BR: Guarde o futon.
translation.en: Put your bedding away.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: を marks 布団 as the direct object of the verb しまう: it is the futon that should be put away.

items.jp: 彼らはワープロにいつも手を焼いている。

translation.pt-BR: Eles vivem tendo problemas com o processador de texto.
translation.en: They're always having trouble with their word processor.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 手 as the object of the verb 焼く within the fixed expression 手を焼く ('to have trouble with').
tokens: object (part of the idiom 手を焼く)

items.jp: 私はタルティーヌはジャムを塗って食べる。

translation.pt-BR: Eu passo geleia na tartine e como.
translation.en: I eat tartine with jam.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ジャム ('jam') as the direct object of the verb 塗る ('to spread/smear').

items.jp: お名前とご住所を伺ってもよろしいでしょうか？

translation.pt-BR: Eu poderia perguntar o seu nome e o seu endereço?
translation.en: May I ask you for your name and address?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: Indicates that 'name and address' is what will be asked by the verb 伺う.

items.jp: お茶又はコーヒーはいかがですか

translation.pt-BR: Que tal um chá ou um café?
translation.en: How about some tea or coffee?

items.label: interrogative particle (か)
items.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question; here it softens the offer, making it a polite invitation: 'how about...?'

items.jp: 冷房を消してもいいですか

translation.pt-BR: Posso desligar o ar-condicionado?
translation.en: May I turn off the air conditioner?

items.label: final question particle
items.explanation: The か at the end turns the sentence into a question, making it a polite request for permission: 'may I turn it off?'

items.jp: そのかばんは外国製ですか

translation.pt-BR: Essa bolsa é importada?
translation.en: Is that bag imported?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end of the sentence turns it into a question, equivalent to the question mark in Portuguese.

items.jp: どこに隠れたらいいですか？

translation.pt-BR: Onde eu devo me esconder?
translation.en: Where can I hide?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か converts the clause into a question: 'where is it good to hide?' → 'where should I hide?'.

items.jp: 猫は椅子の上にいますか、椅子の下にいますか。

translation.pt-BR: O gato está em cima da cadeira ou embaixo da cadeira?
translation.en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?

items.label: interrogative particle (final)
items.explanation: か turns the first part into a question; together with the second か, it creates the alternative 'A or B?'.

items.jp: 猫は椅子の上にいますか、椅子の下にいますか。

translation.pt-BR: O gato está em cima da cadeira ou embaixo da cadeira?
translation.en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?

items.label: interrogative particle (final)
items.explanation: か closes the second question; the pair of か contrasts the two place options.

items.jp: 事態は悪化するのではないかと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que a situação pode acabar piorando.
translation.en: I am afraid things will take a turn for the worse.

items.label: interrogative particle (doubt)
items.explanation: か expresses the internal interrogation 'isn't it that ~?'; combined with ではない it forms ではないか, which softens the statement into a supposition/fear.
tokens: nominal stem of the compound verb (悪 + 化)
verb of the subordinate clause (verbalizing suffix 〜する)

items.jp: 私はその結果がどうかと気をもんでいる。

translation.pt-BR: Estou ansioso para saber qual será o resultado.
translation.en: I feel nervous about the result.

items.label: interrogative particle (in an embedded clause)
items.explanation: か closes the indirect question どうか ('whether/how it will be'), the content of the worry.
tokens: interrogative adverb of the embedded clause
object of the idiom 気をもむ

items.jp: 嫌いな食べ物ってありますか？

translation.pt-BR: Você tem alguma comida de que não gosta?
translation.en: Is there any food you don't like?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question: 'is there...?'. It is the standard way to mark questions in Japanese.

items.jp: 金曜日の午後はお暇ですか。

translation.pt-BR: Você está livre na sexta-feira à tarde?
translation.en: Are you free on Friday afternoon?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the affirmative sentence into a yes/no question.

items.jp: たとえば、標本はいくつですか。

translation.pt-BR: Por exemplo, quantas amostras são?
translation.en: How many samples, for example?

items.label: final question particle
items.explanation: 'か' closes the sentence as a question ('how many are there?').

items.jp: これを壊したのはだれですか。

translation.pt-BR: Quem foi que quebrou isto?
translation.en: Who broke this?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question; with です it forms the polite question ですか.

items.jp: この豚肉は１キロいくらですか。

translation.pt-BR: Quanto custa um quilo desta carne de porco?
translation.en: How much is this pork a kilo?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か turns the statement into a polite question: ですか = 'is it?/does it cost?'. It is what makes the sentence a price question.

items.jp: 「気分はどうですか」と彼は尋ねた。

translation.pt-BR: "Como você está se sentindo?", ele perguntou.
translation.en: "How do you feel?" he inquired.

items.label: final question particle
items.explanation: か closes the quoted speech as a question ('...how is it?').

items.jp: 鏡には似ていないのですか？

translation.pt-BR: Não se parece com um espelho?
translation.en: Doesn't it look like a mirror?

items.label: interrogative particle (か)
items.explanation: か at the end marks the sentence as a question: のですか = 'is it (that)...?', making the interrogation polite and softer.

items.jp: 旅行小切手で払ってもいいですか。

translation.pt-BR: Posso pagar com cheque de viagem?
translation.en: May I pay with a travelers' check?

items.label: question marker
items.explanation: か transforma いいです em pedido de permissão: em vez de afirmar que está bom, pergunta se está.
tokens: meio de pagamento (com 旅行, 'cheque de viagem')

items.jp: お箸で食べるのは難しいですか？

translation.pt-BR: É difícil comer com hashis?
translation.en: Is it difficult to eat with chopsticks?

items.label: final interrogative particle
items.explanation: か at the end turns the statement into a question; with です, it is the polite way of asking.

items.jp: 明日の講義は朝九時からです

translation.pt-BR: A aula de amanhã é a partir das nove da manhã.
translation.en: Tomorrow's class starts at nine in the morning.

items.label: starting-point particle ('from')
items.explanation: から indicates the moment at which something begins: 九時から = 'starting at nine o'clock'.

items.jp: 昨日から風邪をひいている

translation.pt-BR: Estou resfriado desde ontem.
translation.en: I've had a cold since yesterday.

items.label: particle of starting point in time
items.explanation: から marks 昨日 as the moment from which the state began ('since yesterday').
tokens: object (part of the expression 風邪をひく)

items.jp: カーテンがエアコンからの風で揺れている。

translation.pt-BR: A cortina está balançando com o vento do ar-condicionado.
translation.en: The curtain is swaying in the breeze from the air conditioner.

items.label: marker of origin
items.explanation: から indicates that the wind comes from the air conditioner ('from the air conditioner').

items.jp: あのビルの屋上からの展望はすばらしかった。

translation.pt-BR: A vista do alto daquele prédio era maravilhosa.
translation.en: The view from the top of that building was magnificent.

items.label: から of origin/starting point
items.explanation: Marks 屋上 as the place FROM WHICH the view is had: 'from the rooftop.' から indicates physical origin here.
tokens: prenominal adjectival (連体詞) that modifies ビル

items.jp: カーテンから光が漏れる。

translation.pt-BR: A luz vaza pelas cortinas.
translation.en: Light is coming through the curtains.

items.label: marker of origin/point of departure
items.explanation: から indicates the point from which the light comes ('from the curtains, through the curtains').

items.jp: 再来週まで暇がありません

translation.pt-BR: Não tenho tempo livre até daqui a duas semanas.
translation.en: I have no free time until the week after next.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 暇 as the subject that 'exists' (or, in the negative, does not exist). With the verb ある, が is used to indicate that whose existence is being affirmed or denied.

items.jp: 事故で交通が止まりました

translation.pt-BR: O trânsito parou por causa de um acidente.
translation.en: Traffic came to a halt because of an accident.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が points to 'the traffic' as the subject performing the intransitive action of stopping.

items.jp: 失敗したら謝るのが大事です

translation.pt-BR: Quando a gente erra, pedir desculpas é importante.
translation.en: When you make a mistake, apologizing is important.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 謝るの (apologizing) as the subject that receives the quality of 'important'. With adjectives like 大事, the subject is usually marked by が.

items.jp: 父は政治にとても興味がある

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai tem muito interesse por política.
translation.en: My father is very interested in politics.

items.label: marks the subject of ある
items.explanation: が points to 興味 as that which 'exists'. In Japanese, having something abstract is said as 'X が ある' (X exists), so 興味 takes が.

items.jp: 春になると桜が咲きます

translation.pt-BR: Quando chega a primavera, as cerejeiras florescem.
translation.en: When spring comes, the cherry trees bloom.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 桜 as the subject that performs the action of blooming, presenting new information/observation (typical of が for natural phenomena).

items.jp: 赤ちゃんが急に泣き出した

translation.pt-BR: O bebê começou a chorar de repente.
translation.en: The baby suddenly started to cry.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 赤ちゃん as the one who performs the action (the subject that started crying), presenting it as new/observed information.

items.jp: 薬を飲んだら風邪が治った

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e o resfriado passou.
translation.en: I took the medicine and my cold went away.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 風邪 ('cold') as the subject of 治る ('to heal'); it is the cold that was cured, and が highlights this new event.

items.jp: 授業が終わると皆走り出した

translation.pt-BR: Quando a aula acabou, todo mundo saiu correndo.
translation.en: When class ended, everyone rushed out.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 授業 ('class') as the subject of the clause subordinated by と.

items.jp: 彼が怒った訳が分かりません

translation.pt-BR: Não entendo por que ele ficou bravo.
translation.en: I don't understand why he got angry.

items.label: subject marker (within the relative clause)
items.explanation: が marks 彼 as the one who performs the action 怒った within the clause that describes the 訳; that is why we use が and not は, since it is new information within a modifying clause.
tokens: head modified by the relative clause (grammatical subject)

items.jp: 雨が降っています だから傘を持ちます

translation.pt-BR: Está chovendo, então vou levar guarda-chuva.
translation.en: It's raining, so I'm going to take an umbrella.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 雨 (rain) as the subject that performs the action of falling; with natural phenomena new in the discourse one uses が, not は.

items.jp: 狭い駅に人がたくさんいる

translation.pt-BR: Tem muita gente na estação apertada.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marca 'gente' como o sujeito que existe, típico das frases de existência com いる.

items.jp: 玄関に大きな花がある

translation.pt-BR: Tem uma flor grande na entrada.
translation.en: There's a big flower at the entrance.

items.label: subject
items.explanation: が presents the subject that exists; it is the particle used to introduce something new into the scene with ある/いる.

items.jp: 床がぬれていて滑りやすいです

translation.pt-BR: O chão está molhado e escorregadio.
translation.en: The floor is wet and slippery.

items.label: subject particle (が)
items.explanation: Marks 床 (floor) as the subject that is wet; が presents the observed state in a neutral way.

items.jp: 子供たちが教室で騒いでいる

translation.pt-BR: As crianças estão fazendo bagunça na sala de aula.
translation.en: The kids are making a racket in the classroom.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 子供たち as the subject that does the action; it describes an observed scene, hence が and not は.

items.jp: わたしは納豆がきらいです

translation.pt-BR: Eu não gosto de natto.
translation.en: I don't like natto.

items.label: marker of the object of the emotion
items.explanation: With きらい (and also すき/じょうず etc.), that which is hated takes が, not を; here が marks 納豆 as the target of the dislike.
tokens: object of the emotion (the thing that is hated)

items.jp: 店員がお釣りをくれました

translation.pt-BR: O atendente me deu o troco.
translation.en: The clerk gave me my change.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 店員 as the subject who performs the action of giving. が (and not は) is used because it presents the one who did the action as new information/focus.

items.jp: 弟がサッカーで怪我をした

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo se machucou jogando futebol.
translation.en: My younger brother got hurt playing soccer.

items.label: subject particle が
items.explanation: が marks 弟 as the subject that got injured. Here it presents new/concrete information ('it was my brother who got hurt').

items.jp: 冬は暖房代が高いです

translation.pt-BR: No inverno a conta do aquecimento é cara.
translation.en: In winter the heating bill is expensive.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 暖房代 (the heating bill) as the subject that is described as 'expensive'.

items.jp: 鉛筆の先が折れてしまいました

translation.pt-BR: A ponta do lápis acabou quebrando.
translation.en: The tip of the pencil ended up breaking.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が presents 先 as what broke; intransitive verbs of change usually come with が.

items.jp: また傘の忘れ物が多いです

translation.pt-BR: De novo, tem muito guarda-chuva esquecido.
translation.en: Once again, there are lots of forgotten umbrellas.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が points to what is 'many': 忘れ物が多い = 'the forgotten items are many'. With adjectives like 多い, が is usually used to mark that whose quantity is stated.

items.jp: 砂糖がもうなくなった

translation.pt-BR: O açúcar já acabou.
translation.en: The sugar has run out already.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が presents 砂糖 as the subject undergoing the change (ran out); it is used instead of は because it describes a new fact/situation.

items.jp: 母が玄関で待っている

translation.pt-BR: A minha mãe está esperando na entrada.
translation.en: My mom is waiting at the entrance.

items.label: subject
items.explanation: が marks who performs the action of waiting; it points to the mother as the agent.

items.jp: アパートが狭くて困っている

translation.pt-BR: O apartamento é apertado e isso está me incomodando.
translation.en: The apartment is cramped and that's bothering me.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が points to 'apartment' as the subject that is cramped, presenting new/descriptive information.

items.jp: 誰かが玄関に来た

translation.pt-BR: Alguém veio até a porta de entrada.
translation.en: Someone came to the front door.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 誰か (someone) as the one who performs the action of coming. One uses が, and not は, because 'someone' is new information, not something already known.

items.jp: お風呂が沸いたよ

translation.pt-BR: O banho já está pronto!
translation.en: The bath is ready!

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks お風呂 as the subject that became ready. With intransitive 沸く, it is the bath that 'heated up' on its own, so it takes が.

items.jp: 母がお風呂を沸かしてくれた

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe preparou o banho pra mim.
translation.en: My mother ran a bath for me.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が marks 母 as the one who performs the action; with 〜てくれる, the subject in が is the giver of the favor.

items.jp: 店員さんがお釣りをくれました

translation.pt-BR: O atendente me deu o troco.
translation.en: The clerk gave me my change.

items.label: subject marker
items.explanation: が points to 店員さん as who performs the action of giving; with くれる the giver always takes が.

items.jp: 選手が一気に滑降した

translation.pt-BR: O atleta desceu a encosta de uma vez só.
translation.en: The athlete went down the slope all in one go.

items.label: marks the subject
items.explanation: が points to 選手 as the one performing the action of descending.

translation.en: My younger brother got hurt playing soccer.

items.label: means/circumstance particle で
items.explanation: で indicates the activity in which something happened: サッカーで = 'in soccer / playing soccer'. It is the context in which he got hurt.

items.jp: コンビニでお弁当を買う

translation.pt-BR: Compro marmita na lojinha de conveniência.
translation.en: I buy a packed lunch at the convenience store.

items.label: marks the place where the action occurs
items.explanation: で indicates that コンビニ is the place where the purchase happens; one uses で (and not に) because an action is being performed there.

items.jp: 片仮名で名前を書いてください

translation.pt-BR: Escreva seu nome em katakana, por favor.
translation.en: Please write your name in katakana.

items.label: indicates means/instrument
items.explanation: で marks 片仮名 as the means by which one writes: 'in/with katakana'.

items.jp: 大きな鏡で自分をしっかり見詰める

translation.pt-BR: Encare bem você mesmo num espelho grande.
translation.en: Stare at yourself in a large mirror.

items.label: means/instrument
items.explanation: で marks the mirror as the instrument used to perform the action (gazing using a large mirror).

items.jp: 公衆トイレで必ず用を足しておきましょう

translation.pt-BR: Vamos usar o banheiro público antes, sem falta.
translation.en: Be sure to go to the restroom.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates 公衆トイレ as the place where the action (using the restroom) happens.

items.jp: 彼は不注意な運転で事故を起こした。

translation.pt-BR: Ele causou um acidente dirigindo de forma descuidada.
translation.en: He drove carelessly and had an accident.

items.label: means/circumstance marker
items.explanation: で indicates the circumstance or the manner in which the accident occurred: it was 'because of / with careless driving.'
tokens: attributive auxiliary (な form of だ)

items.jp: 彼は縄で木に縛り付けられた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele foi amarrado à árvore com uma corda.
translation.en: He was tied to the tree with a rope.

items.label: instrument particle
items.explanation: で marca 縄 como o instrumento: foi com a corda que o amarraram.

items.jp: この工場ではおもちゃを製造しています。

translation.pt-BR: Nesta fábrica, fabricamos brinquedos.
translation.en: This factory produces toys.

items.label: marker of place where the action occurs
items.explanation: で indicates that the manufacturing takes place inside the factory (place of the action, not destination or existence).
tokens: place of the action (with で); topic (with は)
head of the compound verb 製造する

items.jp: 人工栄養で育てています。

translation.pt-BR: Estou criando com leite em pó.
translation.en: I'm bottle-feeding my baby.

items.label: particle of means/instrument
items.explanation: で marca 人工栄養 como o meio usado na criação da criança.

items.jp: 私は田舎で育てられた。

translation.pt-BR: Fui criado no interior.
translation.en: I was brought up in the country.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates the place where the action of being raised occurred: 'in the countryside'. で marks the setting of an action, different from に (destination/existence).

items.jp: 景色のいいところで車をとめて、休憩しよう。

translation.pt-BR: Vamos parar o carro num lugar com uma bela vista e descansar.
translation.en: Let's stop for a rest somewhere with a good view.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates where the action happens: 'AT the place (with the good view) to stop the car.'

items.jp: この穴を何かで詰めなくては。

translation.pt-BR: Preciso tapar esse buraco com alguma coisa.
translation.en: We've got to fill this hole with something.

items.label: particle of means/instrument
items.explanation: で marca 何か como aquilo com que o buraco vai ser tapado.

items.jp: ガスで調理しますか、あるいは電気ですか。

translation.pt-BR: Você cozinha com gás ou com eletricidade?
translation.en: Do you cook by gas or electricity?

items.label: means/instrument marker
items.explanation: Este で diz com o que se cozinha: ガスで é 'a gás'.

items.jp: これは理屈で割り切れない。

translation.pt-BR: Isto não dá para resolver na base da razão.
translation.en: This is above reason.

items.label: means/instrument marker
items.explanation: で indicates that 理屈 (logic) is the means by which one would try to resolve the matter.

items.jp: 街でアパートを借りたいんです。

translation.pt-BR: É que eu quero alugar um apartamento na cidade.
translation.en: We want to rent an apartment in the city.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates where the action happens: 街で = 'in the city'. Unlike に, で marks the place where something is done (here, renting).

items.jp: 旅行小切手で払ってもいいですか。

translation.pt-BR: Posso pagar com cheque de viagem?
translation.en: May I pay with a travelers' check?

items.label: means/instrument marker
items.explanation: で diz com o que se paga: 旅行小切手で é 'com cheque de viagem'.
tokens: meio de pagamento (com 旅行, 'cheque de viagem')

items.jp: 夜中に台所で物が壊れる音がした。

translation.pt-BR: No meio da noite, ouvi um barulho de algo se quebrando na cozinha.
translation.en: I heard something crashing in the kitchen in the middle of the night.

items.label: marks the place of the action
items.explanation: で indicates the place where the action occurs; here 台所 (kitchen) is where the noise was heard.

items.jp: 平等は憲法で保障されている。

translation.pt-BR: A igualdade é garantida pela Constituição.
translation.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

items.label: means/instrument marker
items.explanation: で marca 憲法 como o instrumento pelo qual a igualdade fica garantida.

items.jp: 転んで足に怪我をした

translation.pt-BR: Caí e machuquei a perna.
translation.en: I fell and hurt my leg.

items.label: connective particle 〜て (chains actions / indicates cause)
items.explanation: Here で is the 〜て form of the verb 転ぶ (it becomes 転んで by euphony). It links 'to fall' to the result 'to hurt the leg', with the sense of 'I fell and then hurt myself'.
tokens: object (part of the expression 怪我をする)

items.jp: 彼は私と固く握手した。

translation.pt-BR: Ele apertou a minha mão com firmeza.
translation.en: He gave me a firm hand grasp.

items.label: accompaniment particle (with)
items.explanation: と marca 私 como a pessoa do outro lado do aperto; sem esse と, o 握手 ficaria sem par.

items.jp: 私はその結果がどうかと気をもんでいる。

translation.pt-BR: Estou ansioso para saber qual será o resultado.
translation.en: I feel nervous about the result.

items.label: quotation/content marker
items.explanation: と takes the question どうか as the content of that which 私 is anxious about.
tokens: interrogative adverb of the embedded clause
object of the idiom 気をもむ

items.jp: 何かペットとか飼ってたりするの？

translation.pt-BR: Você tem algum bicho de estimação, essas coisas?
translation.en: Do you have any pets?

items.label: example/listing particle ('or something like that')
items.explanation: と here is part of とか, which cites 'ペット' as one example among other possible ones ('a pet or something like that').
tokens: auxiliary of the 〜たりする pattern

items.jp: 幸福とお金とが同一視されることがある。

translation.pt-BR: Às vezes felicidade e dinheiro são tratados como a mesma coisa.
translation.en: Happiness is sometimes identified with money.

items.label: enumeration particle ('and')
items.explanation: Este segundo と fecha a lista depois de お金; repetir と no último item é comum quando a enumeração é exaustiva.

items.jp: 綺麗な刀だな。

translation.pt-BR: Que espada bonita.
translation.en: It's a beautiful sword.

items.label: emotive final particle
items.explanation: な no fim não é proibição: vem depois de だ e marca a admiração de quem fala.

items.jp: みんな、チェックが厳しいな。

translation.pt-BR: Gente, a fiscalização tá rigorosa, né.
translation.en: Folks, the enforcement is strict, isn't it.

items.label: exclamatory sentence-final particle (な)
items.explanation: な at the end of the sentence expresses the speaker's emotion/impression and seeks slight agreement, equivalent to 'huh'/'you know' in colloquial English.

items.jp: 公園にたくさんの桜を植えた

translation.pt-BR: Plantaram muitas cerejeiras no parque.
translation.en: They planted many cherry trees in the park.

items.label: place particle (destination/point of the action)
items.explanation: に marks 公園 (park) as the place where the cherry trees were planted, the destination of the action of 植える.

items.jp: 弟は本当に寂しがりだ

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo se sente sozinho muito facilmente.
translation.en: My younger brother gets lonely very easily.

items.label: particle that turns 本当 into an adverb
items.explanation: に attaches to 本当 ('truth') forming 本当に ('really'), functioning as an adverb that intensifies 寂しがり.
tokens: adjective stem (base of 寂しがり)

items.jp: 父は毎週末に魚を釣る

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai pesca todo fim de semana.
translation.en: My father goes fishing every weekend.

items.label: time marker
items.explanation: に fixes the moment when the action happens, attaching to the time expression 毎週末 ('every weekend').

items.jp: 本を棚にきれいに並べた

translation.pt-BR: Arrumei os livros bem certinhos na estante.
translation.en: I arranged the books neatly on the shelf.

items.label: place/destination particle
items.explanation: に marks 棚 (the shelf) as the place where the books were arranged.

items.jp: シャツを水に漬けておいた

translation.pt-BR: Deixei a camisa de molho na água.
translation.en: I soaked the shirt in water.

items.label: means/destination marker
items.explanation: に marks 水 ('water') as the liquid in which the shirt is immersed, as with other uses of 漬ける.

items.jp: 厚い紙にえを描いた

translation.pt-BR: Desenhei numa folha de papel grossa.
translation.en: I drew on a thick sheet of paper.

items.label: target/place particle (に case)
items.explanation: に here marks the surface where the drawing is fixed (on the paper); it indicates the point of application of the action of drawing.

items.jp: ドアに鍵がかけてある

translation.pt-BR: A porta está trancada.
translation.en: The door is locked.

items.label: place/destination particle
items.explanation: に marks the point where the action was performed (on the door), the place where the key was placed and remains.
tokens: subject (the thing that remained in the state)

items.jp: 沖に船が一そう見える

translation.pt-BR: Dá pra ver um barco lá no alto-mar.
translation.en: You can see a boat out on the open sea.

items.label: place particle (where something exists/appears)
items.explanation: に marks 沖 as the point in space where the boat is located and is seen.

items.jp: この橋の下には広い堀がある

translation.pt-BR: Embaixo desta ponte tem um fosso largo.
translation.en: There is a wide moat under this bridge.

items.label: particle of place of existence
items.explanation: に marca この橋の下 como o lugar onde o fosso existe.

items.jp: 昼休みに友達とお弁当を食べた

translation.pt-BR: No intervalo do almoço, comi marmita com um amigo.
translation.en: During the lunch break, I ate a bento with a friend.

items.label: time particle (temporal locative)
items.explanation: に marks 昼休み as the moment of the action: 'at lunch break'. It is used with points/times.

items.jp: この道は車には狭い

translation.pt-BR: Esta rua é estreita demais para carros.
translation.en: This street is too narrow for cars.

items.label: reference / marker
items.explanation: に here indicates the criterion or point of view (for the car), with respect to which the street is judged narrow.

items.jp: 壁にポスターを張る

translation.pt-BR: Colo um pôster na parede.
translation.en: I stick a poster on the wall.

items.label: point of arrival / surface where something is fixed
items.explanation: に here points to the surface where the poster will adhere; with verbs of fixing (張る, 貼る) the destination takes に, not で.
tokens: target / place where it is fixed

items.jp: 本を棚に戻して下さい

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, recoloque o livro na estante.
translation.en: Please put the book back on the shelf.

items.label: destination/particle
items.explanation: に indicates the destination of the action: 棚に = (back) onto the shelf, the place where the book will go.

items.jp: 本棚に本を並べた

translation.pt-BR: Arrumei os livros na estante.
translation.en: I arranged the books on the shelf.

items.label: place/destination particle
items.explanation: に marks 本棚 as the place where the books end up being placed. With verbs of putting/arranging, に indicates the destination point, not the path.

items.jp: 母は野菜を塩に漬ける

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe conserva os legumes no sal.
translation.en: My mother preserves the vegetables in salt.

items.label: means/destination marker
items.explanation: に marks 塩 ('salt') as the medium in which the vegetables are immersed. With 漬ける, に points to the liquid or substance of immersion.

items.jp: 学校にお弁当を持っていく

translation.pt-BR: Levo marmita para a escola.
translation.en: I take a packed lunch to school.

items.label: destination particle
items.explanation: With a movement verb (持っていく), に marks the point of arrival: 'to the school'.

items.jp: クリスマスに木を飾りましょう

translation.pt-BR: Vamos enfeitar a árvore no Natal.
translation.en: Let's decorate the tree at Christmas.

items.label: time particle
items.explanation: に marks クリスマス as the moment when the action happens. に is used with dates and one-off events (at Christmas, at 3 o'clock, on Monday).

items.jp: 選手が一気に滑降した

translation.pt-BR: O atleta desceu a encosta de uma vez só.
translation.en: The athlete went down the slope all in one go.

items.label: turns 一気 into an adverb of manner
items.explanation: に attached to 一気 forms 一気に ("all at once"), describing how the descent was done.
tokens: noun (base of the adverb with に)

items.jp: 玄関にスリッパがならんでいる

translation.pt-BR: Tem chinelos enfileirados na entrada.
translation.en: There are slippers lined up at the entrance.

items.label: marker of the place of existence (in/at)
items.explanation: に indicates the place where the slippers are; with existence/state verbs like ならんでいる, に (not で) is used for the point where something is.

items.jp: 仮に人口が１８００人とします

translation.pt-BR: Vamos supor que a população seja de 1.800 pessoas.
translation.en: Assume that the population is 1,800.

items.label: adverb former
items.explanation: に turns 仮 into 仮に ('hypothetically, let's suppose'), opening the sentence as a supposition.
tokens: base of the adverb 仮に

items.jp: 僕はカーテン越しに海を見た

translation.pt-BR: Olhei o mar através da cortina.
translation.en: He looked at the sea through the curtains.

items.label: particle forming an adverbial phrase
items.explanation: After 越し, forms カーテン越しに ('through the curtain'), indicating the manner/means by which the sea was looked at. に converts the expression into a circumstance of the action.
tokens: modifier (base of カーテン越し)
suffix that forms a phrase (越し)

items.jp: セロリ、プロセスチーズを１ｃｍ角に切る

translation.pt-BR: Corte o aipo e o queijo processado em cubos de 1 cm.
translation.en: Cut the celery and processed cheese into 1cm cubes.

items.label: particle of result/final state
items.explanation: に here indicates the shape the ingredients take after cutting: '(to turn) into 1 cm cubes'. It is the に of result, common in recipes.

items.jp: 電車が、徐々にスピードを落とす

translation.pt-BR: O trem vai reduzindo a velocidade aos poucos.
translation.en: The train slows down little by little.

items.label: forms an adverb from 徐々
items.explanation: に turns 徐々 into an adverb (徐々に = 'gradually'), indicating the manner in which the action happens.
tokens: stem of the adverb 徐々に

items.jp: そこに僕がボールを投げる

translation.pt-BR: Eu vou jogar a bola ali.
translation.en: I will throw the ball there.

items.label: marker of direction/destination
items.explanation: に indicates the target point of the throw (where the ball goes): 'over there'.

items.jp: 彼がすぐにおなかを壊す

translation.pt-BR: Ele fica de barriga ruim com facilidade.
translation.en: He often has stomachaches.

items.label: adverbial form (with すぐ)
items.explanation: に turns すぐ into the adverb すぐに ('soon, easily'), indicating the speed at which it happens.

items.jp: どこに隠れたらいいですか？

translation.pt-BR: Onde eu devo me esconder?
translation.en: Where can I hide?

items.label: place marker (point of existence)
items.explanation: に marks どこ ('where') as the place where the person will be hidden; with 隠れる, に indicates the point at which the action positions the subject.

items.jp: 彼は息子に仕事を譲ることに決めました。

translation.pt-BR: Ele decidiu passar os negócios para o filho.
translation.en: He has decided to turn over his business to his son.

items.label: recipient marker
items.explanation: に marca 息子 como quem recebe os negócios.

items.jp: 彼は私にこの辞書を推薦してくれた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele me recomendou este dicionário.
translation.en: He recommended this dictionary to me.

items.label: recipient particle
items.explanation: に marca 私 como a pessoa a quem o dicionário foi recomendado, no par 推薦してくれた.

items.jp: 結婚して住所や名前が変わった場合は、各機関にその旨を届ける必要があります。

translation.pt-BR: Se o endereço ou o nome mudar depois do casamento, é preciso avisar cada órgão.
translation.en: If your address or name changes after marrying, you need to notify the authorities.

items.label: marks the recipient
items.explanation: に marca 各機関 como o destinatário do aviso: é a cada órgão que a mudança tem que ser comunicada.

items.jp: 先月隣の町にデパートができました。

translation.pt-BR: No mês passado abriu uma loja de departamentos na cidade vizinha.
translation.en: Last month, a department store was built in the town nextdoor.

items.label: marker of the place where something exists/arises
items.explanation: に indicates the place where the store came into existence; with verbs like できる/ある, に is used, not で.

items.jp: 屋根に穴が空いてる。

translation.pt-BR: Tem um buraco no telhado.
translation.en: There are holes in the roof.

items.label: particle of place of existence
items.explanation: に marca 屋根 como o lugar onde o buraco apareceu.

items.jp: 庭の回りに高い塀があった。

translation.pt-BR: Tinha um muro alto em volta do jardim.
translation.en: There was a high wall about the garden.

items.label: particle of place of existence
items.explanation: に marca 庭の回り como o lugar onde o muro estava: com ある, に aponta onde a coisa se encontra.

items.jp: 僕は体育の授業中に怪我をした。

translation.pt-BR: Me machuquei na aula de educação física.
translation.en: I injured myself during the physical education lesson.

items.label: time marker
items.explanation: に fixa o momento: foi durante a aula de educação física que o machucado aconteceu.

items.jp: 叔父は私に車を譲ってくれた。

translation.pt-BR: Meu tio me passou o carro dele.
translation.en: My uncle yielded his car to me.

items.label: recipient marker
items.explanation: に marca 私 como quem recebeu o carro.

items.jp: 秋は読書にもってこいの季節だ。

translation.pt-BR: O outono é a estação perfeita para ler.
translation.en: Fall is a good season for reading.

items.label: purpose/marker
items.explanation: に here indicates what the season is ideal for: 読書に = 'for reading'. It links the activity (reading) to the quality described by もってこい.

items.jp: 授業中に居眠りすることは許しません。

translation.pt-BR: Não vou permitir que ninguém durma durante a aula.
translation.en: I do not allow sleeping in class.

items.label: point-in-time particle
items.explanation: に marca 授業中 como o intervalo em que o cochilo aconteceria: durante a aula.

items.jp: 社長は会議のために顧問たちを集めた。

translation.pt-BR: O presidente reuniu seus conselheiros para a reunião.
translation.en: The president assembled his advisers for a conference.

items.label: purpose particle
items.explanation: Closes the structure のために, giving the meaning 'for / with the aim of.' Here に marks the purpose of the action.

items.jp: 自分の姿を鏡にうつして見なさい。

translation.pt-BR: Olhe a sua própria imagem refletida no espelho.
translation.en: Look at yourself in the mirror.

items.label: marks the place/destination ('in the mirror')
items.explanation: に indicates where the image is projected: 'to reflect in the mirror.' With うつす, に points to the surface where the figure appears.
tokens: complement of place (destination of the projection)

items.jp: 私はその企業に仕事を申し込むつもりだ。

translation.pt-BR: Pretendo me candidatar a uma vaga naquela empresa.
translation.en: I will make an application to that firm for employment.

items.label: recipient marker
items.explanation: に marca その企業 como a quem a candidatura vai ser dirigida.

items.jp: 私によい辞書を推薦してくれませんか。

translation.pt-BR: Você pode me recomendar um bom dicionário?
translation.en: Can you recommend a good dictionary to me?

items.label: recipient particle
items.explanation: に marca 私 como quem receberia a recomendação, o que o してくれる do fim reforça, já que ele indica favor feito a quem fala.

items.jp: 私たちはひじょうに悲しいときに泣きます。

translation.pt-BR: Nós choramos quando estamos muito tristes.
translation.en: We cry when we are very sad.

items.label: particle of time/moment
items.explanation: に here marks the point in time (the 'time' とき) at which the action happens: 'at the time when...'. It is the temporal に that accompanies 〜とき.

items.jp: 結婚のお祝いに、これをお贈りします。

translation.pt-BR: Ofereço isto como presente de casamento.
translation.en: Please accept this gift for the celebration on your wedding.

items.label: purpose particle
items.explanation: に marca 結婚のお祝い como o motivo do presente: isto é oferecido a título de felicitação.

items.jp: 急がなければ汽車に遅れますよ。

translation.pt-BR: Se você não se apressar, vai perder o trem, viu?
translation.en: Be quick, or you will miss the train.

items.label: case particle (target)
items.explanation: に marks the target in relation to which one is late. With 遅れる, に is always used: 汽車に遅れる = 'to be late for the train' (= to miss the train).

items.jp: 急がないと、汽車に遅れるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Se você não se apressar, vai perder o trem, viu?
translation.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.

items.label: case particle (target)
items.explanation: に marks the target of the lateness. The verb 遅れる governs に: 汽車に遅れる = 'to miss the train'.

items.jp: 会ってはじめて本当に人柄がわかるものだ。

translation.pt-BR: É só depois de conhecer alguém que você entende de verdade como a pessoa é.
translation.en: It's not until you have met him that you really understand a man.

items.label: turns 本当 into an adverb
items.explanation: に converts 本当 into 本当に, "truly / really", modifying わかる.

items.jp: まだそのためには機が熟していないと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que ainda não chegou a hora certa para isso.
translation.en: I'm afraid the time is not yet ripe for it.

items.label: purpose particle
items.explanation: に makes up そのために, indicating 'for that purpose'.
tokens: noun of the expression そのために
verb of the expression 機が熟す

items.jp: その男は悪魔に魂を売った。

translation.pt-BR: Aquele homem vendeu a alma ao diabo.
translation.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

items.label: recipient marker
items.explanation: に marca 悪魔 como quem recebe o que foi vendido: a alma foi vendida ao diabo.

items.jp: その学校には立派なプールがある。

translation.pt-BR: Naquela escola há uma piscina excelente.
translation.en: The school boasts a fine swimming pool.

items.label: particle of place of existence
items.explanation: に marks その学校 as the place where something exists: 'at the school'.

items.jp: この森には野ブドウが密集して生えている。

translation.pt-BR: Nesta floresta cresce uva selvagem em abundância.
translation.en: There is a dense growth of vines in this forest.

items.label: particle of place (in/where something exists)
items.explanation: に marks この森 as the place where something exists/grows; it combines with は to thematize the location.
tokens: verbal noun (root of 密集する)

items.jp: この次に償いをするよ。

translation.pt-BR: Da próxima vez eu compenso isso.
translation.en: I will make up for it next time.

items.label: time/point particle
items.explanation: に marks この次 as the future moment ("next time") at which the action will be done. It attaches to the demonstrative この, not to the noun+の pattern.

items.jp: アメリカの会社に就職することにした。

translation.pt-BR: Decidi trabalhar numa empresa americana.
translation.en: I've made up my mind to work for a company in the States.

items.label: destination marker
items.explanation: Este に marca アメリカの会社 como o lugar em que se vai trabalhar; 就職する rege に.

items.jp: うちのママはパパと80年代に結婚したの。

translation.pt-BR: A minha mãe se casou com o meu pai nos anos 80.
translation.en: My mom married my dad in the 80s.

items.label: marks the point in time
items.explanation: に fixes when the action occurred: 'in the 80s' (80年代に).
